---
title: "Supplemental descriptive analysis"
output: html_document
---

This optional view uses the same implementation as `python run.py descriptive`.
Set `DAO_BIAS_ROOT` and `DAO_BIAS_DATA_ROOT` before rendering.
Optionally set `DAO_BIAS_OUTPUT_ROOT`; the default is `outputs/` inside the package.

```{r}
root <- Sys.getenv("DAO_BIAS_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) stop("Set DAO_BIAS_ROOT to the installed package")
source(file.path(root,"src/r/runtime/context.R"))
source(file.path(root,"src/r/runtime/init.R"))
source(file.path(root,"src/r/reporting/descriptive.R"))
run_descriptive_analysis(analysis_context(root))
```
